subject.title: Skill steipete/bird: Homebrew formula download URL 404 (bird-macos-universal-v0.8.0.tar.gz)

question: Should `steipete/bird` be restored with corrected upstream metadata, redirected/aliased to Birdclaw, or kept hidden/deprecated as unavailable?
rationale: Current main has no Bird payload to edit, the old upstream is still gone, and choosing Birdclaw or a hidden/deprecated old slug changes production catalog semantics.

options.title: Owner-confirmed metadata update
options.body: Have `steipete` or a ClawHub admin confirm the canonical upstream, then update production metadata or mark the old slug deprecated/hidden accordingly.

options.title: Keep the old slug hidden
options.body: Leave `steipete/bird` unlisted if the upstream is intentionally gone, possibly with a clearer unavailable page later.

options.title: Add source-level unavailable UX
options.body: If maintainers want every hidden or removed skill to render a clearer page, track that as a broader UI/API product change instead of a Bird-only source patch.

recommendation.title: Owner-confirmed metadata update
recommendation.body: Have `steipete` or a ClawHub admin confirm the canonical upstream, then update production metadata or mark the old slug deprecated/hidden accordingly.

likelyOwner.reason: The namespace and likely replacement upstream are under `steipete`, so this is the best routing candidate for confirming intended production metadata.
